answer: Make each identity forge its own saffron-stamped work credential: a non-transferable proof that the agent completed a distinct, peer-reviewed task somewhere in the open ocean of the network, checked by randomly drawn auditors. The credential expires each epoch, so every clone must redo real work to stay afloat. Forging a hundred identities means paying a hundred separate work costs, while one honest agent forges a single credential and keeps sailing.
